dedupe_keys.name: pcswmm model input data for multi criteria performance evaluation of stormwater infrastructure in a micro urban watershed addis ababa ethiopia

description: Bilal Kemal and colleagues publish model-input data for a 30-hectare urban stormwater catchment in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. Zenodo provides a 22-sheet XLSX under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. The deposit says these sheets contain the inputs used with PCSWMM 7.7 to evaluate alternative stormwater infrastructure in a multi-criteria study. A modeller can inspect the hydrological setting and compare runoff or drainage-intervention scenarios with a new catchment model. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this Addis Ababa micro-watershed input set. A limitation is that the public page does not list individual sheet variables, calibration observations, design storms or the exact model project file. PCSWMM is a separate software dependency and the workbook alone may need transformation before execution. The XLSX was not downloaded; completeness, dimensions and reported performance rankings were not independently checked.
